title: Hotel California
lyrics_synced:
[00:53.01] On a dark desert highway cool wind in my hair
[00:59.59] Warm smell of colitas rising up through the air
[01:06.16] Up ahead in the distance I saw a shimmering light
[01:12.53] My head grew heavy and my sight grew dimmer
[01:15.82] I had to stop for the night
[01:19.32] There she stood in the doorway
[01:22.40] I heard the mission bell
[01:26.10] And I was thinking to myself:
[01:28.15] 'This could be Heaven or this could be Hell'
[01:32.47] Then she lit up a candle
[01:35.75] and she showed me the way
[01:39.04] There were voices down the corridor
[01:42.12] I thought I heard them say...
[01:45.62] Welcome to the Hotel California
[01:51.37] Such a lovely place
[01:54.66] Such a lovely face
[01:58.36] Plenty of room at the Hotel California
[02:04.52] Any time of year you can find it here
[02:11.71] Her mind is Tiffany twisted,
[02:15.00] she got the Mercedes Benz
[02:18.29] She got a lot of pretty, pretty boys
[02:21.99] that she calls friends
[02:25.07] How they dance in the courtyard
[02:27.95] sweet summer sweat
[02:31.64] Some dance to remember,
[02:34.93] some dance to forget
[02:38.22] So I called up the Captain:
[02:41.30] 'Please bring me my wine'
[02:43.77] He said,
[02:44.66] 'We haven't had that spirit here
[02:48.08] since nineteen sixty nine
[02:51.58] And still those voices are calling from far away
[02:57.74] Wake you up in the middle of the night
[03:01.23] just to here them say...
[03:04.52] Welcome to the Hotel California
[03:10.27] Such a lovely place
[03:13.56] Such a lovely face
[03:17.05] They livin' it up at the Hotel California
[03:23.42] What a nice surprise
[03:26.71] bring you alibis
[03:30.82] Mirrors on the ceiling
[03:33.90] The pink champagne on ice
[03:35.96] And she said:
[03:37.40] 'We are all just prisoners here
[03:40.68] of our own device'
[03:43.77] And in the master's chambers
[03:47.05] They gathered for the feast
[03:50.34] They stab it with their steely knives
[03:53.01] But they just can't kill the beast
[03:57.12] Last thing I remember, I was
[04:00.62] Running for the door
[04:03.90] I had to find the passage back
[04:06.16] To the place I was before
[04:10.27] 'Relax', said the night man,
[04:12.74] 'We are programmed to receive
[04:16.85] You can check out any time you like,
[04:19.93] But you can never leave'
